question: Classical wave theory predicts that there should be a significant time delay (minutes or hours) between the incidence of dim light and the emission of photoelectrons. What is the physical reasoning behind this prediction of a time lag?

options.A: The light wave needs time to travel from the source to the metal plate
options.B: The energy of the wave is distributed continuously over the wavefront, so a single electron absorbs energy very slowly
options.C: The electrons are heavy particles and have high inertia
options.D: The metal surface reflects most of the initial waves before absorption begins
